requirements.description: Every game route resolves player identity from the authenticated server session and preserves complete cross-user isolation.
requirements.notes: Body and query player identifiers are compatibility inputs only and cannot override a bound session.

requirements.description: Game clients submit bounded intent only; privilege, wallet, RNG, outcome, payout, and round-control fields are removed before dispatch.
requirements.notes: Unauthorized fields are safely canonicalized without changing the frozen v1 response envelope.

requirements.description: Randomness, hidden state, game outcomes, and payouts are selected by server game engines and never by browser or native client payloads.
requirements.notes: The former Roulette force-result HTTP seam is removed; deterministic seams remain internal to tests and engines.

requirements.description: The server revalidates legal action, round ownership, phase, turn, wager, precision, balance, and game configuration for every catalog action.
requirements.notes: The catalog matrix binds every state-changing OpenAPI operation to its server route, service, and engine owners.

requirements.description: Every nonzero game debit, credit, refund, and settlement is server-owned and uses the storage transaction and append-only ledger.
requirements.notes: Wallet refresh and ledger evidence are checked for accepted, rejected, and cross-user attempts.

requirements.description: Exact action retries replay the original committed receipt, changed action-key reuse conflicts, and restart or lost-response recovery cannot duplicate value.
requirements.notes: Certification reuses the provider-backed action journal, semantic fingerprint, and per-game receipt tests.

requirements.description: At least twenty-five simultaneous duplicate submissions per debit, payout, refund, and settlement family commit at most once across supported storage processes.
requirements.notes: The permanent storage suite covers thread/process concurrency and provider transaction invariants; live-provider execution remains opt-in when configured.

requirements.description: Admin and operations authority is enforced by authenticated server routes, and normal players cannot obtain global game, ledger, history, user, or control state.
requirements.notes: The integrated API suite checks every published Admin path under a normal authenticated user.

requirements.description: The certification inventory covers every registered catalog game and action, and an authoritative refresh replaces tampered client wallet presentation without changing server state.
requirements.notes: Catalog or OpenAPI mutation drift fails contract and API validation until the matrix is regenerated and reviewed; issue #95 extends the accepted inventory to 30 games.

requirements.description: Fixed-limit Texas Hold'em deals one authenticated human and three server-managed opponents through shared card and poker primitives with call-or-fold streets and transparent showdown settlement.
requirements.notes: Server game logic owns legal turns, hidden cards, random outcomes, and payout math under SEC-003 and SEC-004.

requirements.description: Authenticated sessions own private reload-safe hands, decisions, compact replay receipts, settled history, and canonical route restoration without exposing active opponent cards or another user's state.
requirements.notes: Session context overrides caller player ids, hostile protected fields are removed, and authoritative refresh restores server-owned state under SEC-001, SEC-002, and SEC-009.

requirements.description: The human and all three funded opponent accounts reserve maximum exposure and receive unused escrow and pot shares only through storage-enforced ledger action identities with Admin-auditable owner context.
requirements.notes: Consumes accepted issues #190 and #189 and satisfies SEC-005 through SEC-008 without direct balance mutation.

requirements.description: Texas Hold'em Practice Table supplies complete English and Russian responsive, accessible, reduced-motion-safe, timer-clean play across all governed viewports.
requirements.notes: After-pass evidence covers both locales, every viewport, every decision street, settlement, reduced motion, route restoration, and authoritative refresh after client tampering.

requirements.description: Catalog, contract, browser, restart, long-suite, funded-opponent, version, requirement, visual, and hostile-client certification evidence remains traceable for Texas Hold'em Practice Table.
requirements.notes: Descriptor sort order 200 and every mutation action are included in the accepted SEC-001 through SEC-009 certification matrix.

requirements.description: Anonymous liveness reports only a fixed live process state without storage access, build metadata, timestamps, heartbeat state, or dependency diagnostics.
requirements.notes: Allocated by GitHub issue #77 for issue #72; /healthz is the only anonymous Operations route.

requirements.description: Authenticated readiness checks configured JSON or MySQL storage with bounded waits and returns only allowlisted provider, component state, and fixed degraded reason codes.
requirements.notes: Raw exceptions, credentials, hosts, database names, paths, request ids, and debug text are never returned.

requirements.description: Successful dependency checks advance a monotonic process-local heartbeat timestamp, while later degradation retains the last successful value and restart resets it.
requirements.notes: Heartbeat diagnostics are visible only through authenticated Admin telemetry.

requirements.description: Admin presents live, degraded, and client-derived down Operations states in English and Russian with text plus a non-color signal and no raw diagnostics.
requirements.notes: The browser infers down only from a failed transport because an unavailable process cannot report its own state.

requirements.description: Copied-deployment smoke records the loopback child PID and port, probes anonymous liveness plus authenticated readiness and Admin telemetry, verifies sanitized build provenance, stops the child, and proves the port closed.
requirements.notes: The harness always binds 127.0.0.1 on an OS-assigned port and records exact listener cleanup.

requirements.description: Operations regression evidence covers anonymous and authenticated policy, healthy and degraded dependencies, Admin authorization, EN/RU responsive states, copied deployment, and listener cleanup.
requirements.notes: Allocated by GitHub issue #77 for the accepted issue #72 implementation and shared integration gate.

requirements.description: A production WSGI adapter initializes from explicit external runtime configuration, serves the complete same-origin application without invoking the development HTTP server, and is supported only through a fixed-loopback supervised process policy.
requirements.notes: Issue #202 owns the repository-only adapter and lifecycle packet; trusted-proxy, cookie, CSRF, security-header, schema, edge, and host mutation remain outside this requirement.

requirements.description: Production-service validation covers listener-free WSGI parity, sanitized probes, authorization propagation, malformed input, fail-closed external configuration, fixed-loopback policy, hardened supervision, clean extracted-release startup, graceful restart, persistence, failure handling, and exact listener closure.
requirements.notes: The copied-release process smoke uses an operating-system-assigned IPv4 loopback port, never selects 8765 or 8877, and defers MySQL restart proof until issue #204 releases migrations.
